subject.title: codex app-server drops guardianWarning on rejection circuit-breaker interrupts

question: Should maintainers accept the linked projector-only fix now, or require terminal attempt metadata/user-visible final output in the same fix before closing this issue?
rationale: The source bug is narrow and has an open candidate PR, but the issue’s requested outcome includes user-visible explanation while the current candidate fix preserves the warning in agent events first.

options.title: Land projector fix first
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101220, then keep any broader final-output placement as a follow-up if needed.

options.title: Require metadata before close
options.body: Ask the fix PR to also preserve the warning in terminal attempt metadata or final user-visible interrupted-turn output before the issue is resolved.

options.title: Batch with broader Codex UX work
options.body: Keep the issue open as maintainer-owned Codex app-server UX work if warning placement should be decided with a broader interruption/guardian surface pass.

recommendation.title: Land projector fix first
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101220, then keep any broader final-output placement as a follow-up if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: The current linked fix PR is assigned to vincentkoc, so he is the clearest live owner for the review decision even though steipete has the stronger code-history signal.
